cd /workspace/project && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json, urllib.request, urllib.error, concurrent.futures
d=json.load(open('/tmp/ob_live.json'))
funded=[x for x in d if (x['saldo'] or 0)>0]
def chat(x):
    body={"model":"deepseek/deepseek-v4.1-flash-1017-uncensored","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"balas satu kata: ok"}],"max_tokens":10}
    r=urllib.request.Request('https://obscurify.ai/v1/chat/completions',data=json.dumps(body).encode(),
        headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+x['key'],'Content-Type':'application/json'})
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(r,timeout=90) as resp:
            j=json.load(resp)
            return x, True, j['choices'][0]['message']['content'][:20]
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        return x, False, f'http{e.code}'
    except Exception as e:
        return x, False, type(e).__name__
ok=0; bad=[]

with concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor(6) as ex:
    for x,s,msg in ex.map(chat,funded):
        if s: ok+=1
        else: bad.append((x['akun'],msg))
print(f"chat OK : {ok}/{len(funded)}")
print(f"gagal   : {len(bad)}")
for b in bad[:6]: print("  ",b)
EOF
chat OK : 99/99
gagal   : 0
